title: A/R Detail: the text column headers sort A to Z, then Z to A
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • In the "1-30 days past due" bucket there are three open documents: {Document-A} for {Customer-C} at {Location-B}, and {Document-B} for {Customer-A} and {Document-C} for {Customer-B} at {Location-A}; one of the three is a different transaction type from the others.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-07 Alder, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-07 Birch and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-07 Cedar; {Document-A} and {Document-B} are invoices and {Document-C} is a credit memo.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the "1-30 days past due" bucket expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Location" header.
  2. Click the "Location" header again.
  3. Click the "Location" header a third time.
  4. Click the "Transaction type" header.
  5. Click the "Transaction type" header again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: rows inside each aging bucket sort by Location, A to Z: in the "1-30 days past due" bucket the {Location-A} rows come before the {Location-B} row.
  • Step 2: Z to A: the {Location-B} row comes first.
  • Step 3: A to Z again, as in step 1. There is no unsorted state.
  • Step 4: rows inside each aging bucket sort by Transaction type, A to Z: read the Transaction type words top to bottom in the "1-30 days past due" bucket; they are in alphabetical order.
  • Step 5: Z to A: the same words in reverse alphabetical order.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R1, A/R Detail columns: “A/R Detail: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction type, ID, Customer full name, Due date, Amount, Open balance.”
  • S2-R1: “Every column on all six reports sorts when its header is clicked, except A/P Unpaid Invoices' Vendor Name column (S2-N1). The columns are:”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first. The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
  • S2-R5: “On the grouped reports, a header click sorts the rows inside each group; the groups themselves never move (S1-R5, S1-R6).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p1-click-the-total-header.png: figure "Click the Total header" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"
  • ar-ap-p1-a-p-aging-detail-opens-by-vendor-name.png: figure "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"

The design's own words:

  • "First click gives the useful order: money largest first. Second click reverses, third repeats the first. S2-R1, S2-R2, S2-R3, S2-R7." (caption of "Click the Total header")
  • "Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name")

Difference from the PRD (DD-06): the PRD says A/R Detail and A/R Collection headings written "Transaction type", "Customer full name", "Due date", "Past due", "Open balance" (S2-R1); the design shows the after pictures read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Open Balance"; today's production pictures already read the same, with "Location Full Name". This case follows the PRD; the difference is question 4 on Chris Ward's sheet (sent 22 Oct 2026); the design version is held in D-81.
